killer_family.definition: S_m = AND_i (x_i1 OR x_i2 OR x_i3) on m disjoint triples

proof_core: Every block projection of an affine subspace contained in S_m is an affine subspace of GF(2)^3 avoiding 000, hence has dimension <=2; injectivity into the product of block projections gives global dimension <=2m.
